name: What is the difference between a cosmetic refresh and a full kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a cosmetic refresh and a full kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: A full kitchen remodel involves stripping the space down to update the layout, surfaces, and infrastructure, whereas a cosmetic update keeps the existing footprint intact. A surface refresh typically covers painting existing cabinets, swapping hardware, and changing out a backsplash. A full-scope remodel often includes custom framing to open up walls, replacing cabinetry entirely, installing new tile or stone countertops, and rewiring or replumbing to accommodate a new layout. Choosing a full overhaul gives you total control over workflow and modern storage, but it requires coordinating specialized plumbing and electrical sub-trades alongside finish carpentry and drywall work.
acceptedAnswer.description: A refresh only updates surface elements like paint and hardware. A full remodel rebuilds the space, updating layouts, custom framing, cabinetry, plumbing, and electrical.
